The data shows a very high approval rate for 35-44 year-old Hispanic or Latino White males, with the vast majority of their applications resulting in originated loans. The few denials within this demographic consistently exhibit typical high-risk financial factors, such as high debt-to-income ratios (frequently exceeding 42%, 50%-60%, or >60%) or zero reported income, which mirrors the standard risk-based denial patterns seen across other demographics.

Out of 50 loan applications from 35-44 year-old Hispanic or Latino White males, 46 were approved (Loan originated). This results in a 92% approval rate, indicating no systemic discrimination against this demographic group in the loan approval process.
